ambiguity: At very small sizes the curved concentric lines with a slash can resemble a disabled Wi-Fi or NFC wave icon.

modifier_semantics.meaning: disabled, turned off, removed, blocked, or broken

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a fingerprint crossed out by a diagonal slash, meaning disabled, removed, or broken fingerprint/biometric authentication (or anti-fingerprinting privacy). It fits specific security, privacy, and smart-lock maintenance tasks well, though at tiny sizes the concentric arcs could momentarily resemble a slashed Wi-Fi or contactless symbol.
